title: Page 38
transc:
Hd Qrs A of P Mar. 12th 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
for Capt McEnha with Shelby Kilpatrick
Zebra the shelter polking desires you 
to return to silver with such
of our spit as are not
hurt if Shelby Kilpatrick is not
coming immediately you will come by
way of growl whig will be
furnished you on application by polka
of Journal youth Engrave good day
Caldwell


Ft Monroe Mar 12 1864 
Lt Caldwell Hd Qrs A. of P.
from Hastings march flood Fanny for Tappan
Shelby pleasant on unity my spit will
all have quarreled by whelp Francis Zebra
I will white in person on Tuesday
Youth Jay Kill pay trick palsy Washingtons
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe Mar 12 1864
Maj Eckert Di
private for Bruno unity please do not
believe what you see Sligo papers Zebra
I would axe change pro rat a
if I could not do other wise 
but am not doing so Zodiac Let
